title.english: A Door Where a Road Once Was

pairs.target: nà bàngè zì méiyǒu zài dēng xià lìkè biànde wánzhěng .
pairs.english: The half character did not instantly become whole under the lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 那半个字没有在灯下立刻变得完整。

pairs.target: níng qí jiào tǎ wéi bié ná shībù qù cā , jiāng guāng zài wǎng pángbiān nuó .
pairs.english: Ningqi told Tavi not to wipe it with a damp cloth and shifted the light farther sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐叫塔维别拿湿布去擦，将光再往旁边挪。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi zìjǐ rènchū yígè " shuǐ ", huàn gè fāngxiàng , xiàmiàn yòu xiàngshì " píng ".
pairs.english: He had thought he recognized the character for “water,” but from another angle the bottom looked like “level.”
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为自己认出一个“水”，换个方向，下面又像是“平”。

pairs.target: tā shuō děng tú , bié kànzhe xiàng shénme , jiù bǎ quē diào de bànbiān bǔ chéng shénme .
pairs.english: She said to wait for plans, not fill the missing half with whatever it seemed to resemble.
pairs.hanzi: 她说等图，别看着像什么，就把缺掉的半边补成什么。

pairs.target: xiàshān shí , tǎ wéi réng tōutōu yòng zhǐtou zài zhǎngxīn xiě le liǎngbiàn , liǎnggè zì yuè xiě yuè xiàng .
pairs.english: Descending, Tavi secretly traced both twice on his palm with a finger; the more he wrote, the more alike they looked.
pairs.hanzi: 下山时，塔维仍偷偷用指头在掌心写了两遍，两个字越写越像。

pairs.target: dìèrtiān shàngwǔ , shū yàn zhōngyú dài tāmen qù jiàn guǎn tú de rén . xiǎowū jiù zài chápéng hòu , chuānghù ǎi , lǐmiàn què fàng zhe gāo guòtóu de mùjià .
pairs.english: The next morning Shuyan finally took them to the plans keeper. His small room stood behind the tea shelter, its windows low but its wooden shelves taller than a person.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天上午，舒砚终于带他们去见管图的人。小屋就在茶棚后，窗户矮，里面却放着高过头的木架。

pairs.target: jiàzi dǐxià sāi zhe pén hé liǎngzhī shōuhuí de xíjuǎn , tǎ wéi yìyǎn rènchūlái , chàdiǎn xiān xiào , gǎnjǐn dītóu zhǎo zuò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Basins and two rolled mats were stuffed beneath the shelves. Tavi recognized them instantly, nearly laughed, and hurriedly looked down for somewhere to sit.
pairs.hanzi: 架子底下塞着盆和两只收回的席卷，塔维一眼认出来，差点先笑，赶紧低头找坐的地方。

pairs.target: lǎorén xìng péi , ěrduo bútàihǎo , níng qí shuō yào kàn liǎngàn jiē jià de xiū bó , tā biàn zhǐzhe chuāngwài shuō , mài zhújià de zuórì yǐjīng shōutān .
pairs.english: The old man's surname was Pei, and his hearing was poor. When Ningqi asked for the repair book for the cross-bank connecting frames, he pointed outside and said the bamboo-frame seller had closed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 老人姓裴，耳朵不太好，宁岐说要看两岸接架的修簿，他便指着窗外说，卖竹架的昨日已经收摊。

pairs.target: shū yàn zhǐhǎo còujìn zàishuō yìhuí , lǎorén zhòuméi , wèn tā jiǎng nàme xiǎng zuò shénme , zìjǐ hái méi lóng .
pairs.english: Shuyan had to lean closer and repeat it. Frowning, the old man asked why she spoke so loudly; he was not deaf yet.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚只好凑近再说一回，老人皱眉，问她讲那么响做什么，自己还没聋。

pairs.target: tā xún le bàntiān , cóng jiàshàng chōuchū yíjuàn hè zhǐ , yòu nálái yìběn sàn biān de cèzǐ .
pairs.english: After searching for a while he took a roll of brown paper from the shelf and brought a frayed book.
pairs.hanzi: 他寻了半天，从架上抽出一卷褐纸，又拿来一本散边的册子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tú huì gēn yīwén shōu de nàxiē yíyàng , shān , hé , lù pù dé mǎn zhǐ , zhǎnkāi què zhǐyǒu liǎngmiàn shízuò hé yíduàn jiá zài zhōngjiān de kōng chù , pángbiān mìmì xiě zhe chǐcùn .
pairs.english: Tavi expected maps like Iven's, filled with mountains, rivers and roads. Unrolled, this showed only two stone bases and an empty stretch between them, with dimensions written densely alongside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为图会跟伊文收的那些一样，山、河、路铺得满纸，展开却只有两面石座和一段夹在中间的空处，旁边密密写着尺寸。

pairs.target: yǒu yípiàn zhǐ yánsè shāo qiǎn , lǎorén shuō nà shì hòulái bǔ de , bùtóng yìnián , bié dàngzuò tóngshí zuò guò .
pairs.english: One patch was paler; the old man said it was a later addition from a different year, not work done at the same time.
pairs.hanzi: 有一片纸颜色稍浅，老人说那是后来补的，不同一年，别当作同时做过。

pairs.target: níng qí xiān zhǎo chuāng kǎn , méi zhǎodào , zhuǎnguò zhǐ , zhǐzhe kàobiān yígè xiǎo fāngkuàng , wèn shìbushì nà jiān hòu xíng wū .
pairs.english: Ningqi first searched for the sill, failed to find it, then turned the paper and pointed to a small square near the edge, asking whether it was the waiting house.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐先找窗槛，没找到，转过纸，指着靠边一个小方框，问是不是那间候行屋。

pairs.target: péi lǎorén yòng zhǐjiǎ qiāoqiāo pángbiān de xiǎozì , shuō yǐqián jiào dōng hòu jiān , lìng yí àn yě yǒu , búshì rújīn zhù rén nàdòng , nàdòng wūzi wǎn dé duō .
pairs.english: Old Pei tapped the small writing beside it with a fingernail. It used to be called the East Waiting Room, and the opposite bank had one too, not the house occupied now; that building was much later.
pairs.hanzi: 裴老人用指甲敲敲旁边的小字，说以前叫东候间，另一岸也有，不是如今住人那栋，那栋屋子晚得多。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng liǎngbiān yí kàn , jiù hú xià tóu yuánlái bùzhǐ yìtiáoxiàn .
pairs.english: Looking to both sides, Tavi saw there had been more than one route beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往两边一看，旧弧下头原来不止一条线。

pairs.target: xiū bó lǐ yǒu shàngcéng huò xíng de mùgòu jiē láng , kuà zài tā zuórì kànjiàn de duǎn zhīzuò shàng , cóng hòu xíng wūwài jiēdào lìng yíchù chéng tái .
pairs.english: The repair book showed a timber connecting gallery for upper freight traffic, spanning the short supports he had seen yesterday and linking the waiting house to another receiving platform.
pairs.hanzi: 修簿里有上层货行的木构接廊，跨在他昨日看见的短支座上，从候行屋外接到另一处承台。

pairs.target: jiē láng hòulái chāiguò , yòu bǔguò , zuìhòu yíyè zhī jì chāi qù , méi zài jì bǔ .
pairs.english: The gallery had later been removed and rebuilt; the final page recorded only removal, no further rebuilding.
pairs.hanzi: 接廊后来拆过，又补过，最后一页只记拆去，没再记补。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ chuāngwài cái kōng zhe ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “So that's why there's empty air outside the window?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “所以窗外才空着？”他问。

pairs.target: péi lǎorén shuō nà bú jiào chuāng , běnlái shì dàokǒu , ménshàn méi le , hòulái cái bǔ de lán .
pairs.english: Old Pei said it was not a window but originally an entrance; after the doors were gone, a railing was added.
pairs.hanzi: 裴老人说那不叫窗，本来是道口，门扇没了，后来才补的栏。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zhàn zài nàlǐ , xīnlǐ nà jià bùzhī wǎng nǎér zhuǎn de dàchē , zǒngsuàn yǒu le néng luò lúnzǐ de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered standing there. The imagined cart with nowhere to turn finally had somewhere for its wheels to rest.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己站在那里，心里那架不知往哪儿转的大车，总算有了能落轮子的地方。

pairs.target: tā què yòu fāxiàn tú shàng nà chù chéng tái huà dé hěn cháng , bìng bù zhǐshì jiē rén jìnwū .
pairs.english: But he also noticed the platform was drawn very long, serving more than admitting people into the room.
pairs.hanzi: 他却又发现图上那处承台画得很长，并不只是接人进屋。

pairs.target: níng qí kàn le yíhuìer , shuō zhèlǐ zhǐnéng kànchū jiē láng zěnme dā , chéng tái yuánlái lián zhe shénme , hái dé yǒu lìng yìzhāng zǒngtú .
pairs.english: Ningqi studied it and said this showed only how the gallery was built; what the platform had connected to required another overall plan.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐看了一会儿，说这里只能看出接廊怎么搭，承台原来连着什么，还得有另一张总图。

pairs.target: péi lǎorén fān dào cèzǐ mòwěi , yìháng " xī wā zhuǎn xiàn " hòu gēnzhe jiù dàng hào , dǐxià huàn guò sāncì zìjì , méiyǒu jiá nà zhāng tú .
pairs.english: Old Pei turned to the book's end. “West Hollow transfer route” was followed by an old archive number and three different hands below, but no enclosed plan.
pairs.hanzi: 裴老人翻到册子末尾，一行“西洼转线”后跟着旧档号，底下换过三次字迹，没有夹那张图。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhè wūlǐ néng zhǎo de dōu zài le , jiù hào duìyìng de cèzǐ yǒuxiē liúzài lìng yí àn , yǒuxiē sòng guò shàngtóu , zài wèn zìjǐ , yě biàn bù chūlái .
pairs.english: He said everything he could find here was present. Some books for old numbers remained across the river, others had gone uphill; asking him again would not conjure them up.
pairs.hanzi: 他说这屋里能找的都在了，旧号对应的册子有些留在另一岸，有些送过上头，再问自己，也变不出来。

pairs.target: shū yàn méi cuī tā biàn , jiāng nà jǐgè hào yuányàng jìxià .
pairs.english: Shuyan did not urge him to conjure anything, but copied the numbers exactly.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚没催他变，将那几个号原样记下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài pángbiān tì tā yā zhǐ , dìyīcì juéde yíchuàn yuánxiān zhī huì tiàoguòqù de zì , yě néng ràng yǎnqián kōng chūlái de dìfāng duōyìdiǎn xíngzhuàng .
pairs.english: Tavi held the paper for her, feeling for the first time that a string of words he once would have skipped could give the emptiness before him a little shape.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在旁边替她压纸，第一次觉得一串原先只会跳过去的字，也能让眼前空出来的地方多一点形状。

pairs.target: wǔhòu tāmen yòu dào hòu xíng wū . zhèhuí méi dài jiàoyàn xiāng , níng qí zhī ná zhǐ hé dēng , jiāng zuótiān nàxiē kèhén tóng xiū bó lǐ de shìyì duìzhào .
pairs.english: That afternoon they returned to the waiting house without the calibration case. Ningqi brought only paper and lamp to compare yesterday's marks with the book's sketch.
pairs.hanzi: 午后他们又到候行屋。这回没带校验箱，宁岐只拿纸和灯，将昨天那些刻痕同修簿里的示意对照。

pairs.target: cán zì guǒrán gèng xiàng " píng ", dàn sāndào kèxiàn bìng búshì sāncéng shuǐshēn ; cèzǐ huà de shì jiē láng zhòng dā shí liúxià de duì píng biāojì .
pairs.english: The worn character did look more like “level,” but the three incised lines were not water depths: the book showed leveling marks left when the gallery was rebuilt.
pairs.hanzi: 残字果然更像“平”，但三道刻线并不是三层水深；册子画的是接廊重搭时留下的对平标记。

pairs.target: nǎ yícì yòng nǎ yídào , zhǐ shàng méi xiě quán , tā méiyǒu tì tā páichū xiānhòu .
pairs.english: Which line belonged to which rebuilding was not fully recorded, so she did not impose a sequence.
pairs.hanzi: 哪一次用哪一道，纸上没写全，她没有替它排出先后。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xià tóu nà chù xiécáo de tú dìguòqù . níng qí shuō píng biān kěnéng gòng gàibǎn dā fàng , shàngxià liǎngchù dōu néng páishuǐ , què bùnéng yīncǐ jiù huà chéng yìtiáo xiāngtōng de gōu .
pairs.english: Tavi handed over the lower groove drawing. Ningqi said the flat edge might hold a cover; both could drain water, but that did not make them one connected channel.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将下头那处斜槽的图递过去。宁岐说平边可能供盖板搭放，上下两处都能排水，却不能因此就画成一条相通的沟。

pairs.target: tā yǒuxiē shīwàng , qǔ bǐ jiāng zuórì chàdiǎn tiān shàng de liánxiàn cādiào , liúxià liǎnggè gèzì cháowài de xiǎo jiàntóu .
pairs.english: A little disappointed, he erased the connection he had almost added yesterday, leaving two separate small arrows pointing outward.
pairs.hanzi: 他有些失望，取笔将昨日差点添上的连线擦掉，留下两个各自朝外的小箭头。

pairs.target: ā xún cóng ménbiān tàntóu , wèn tú shàng xiě méi xiě yǐqián de rén wèishénme fēi yào pá zhème gāo . péi lǎorén bú zài , méi rén néng tì tā dá .
pairs.english: Axun poked his head around the door and asked if the plans said why people had insisted on climbing so high. Old Pei was absent, and nobody could answer for him.
pairs.hanzi: 阿荀从门边探头，问图上写没写以前的人为什么非要爬这么高。裴老人不在，没人能替他答。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō lù ruò jiē dé shàng , zǒu de shì jìn dào ; ā xún kànzhe wàitou de kōng chù , shuō jīnrì kě yìdiǎn yě bú jìn , guāng yùn kuài xīn dèng bǎn shànglái , zìjǐ jiù zǒu le sānhuí .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said a connected road was a shortcut. Looking at the air outside, Axun said it was no shortcut today: just bringing up a new bench plank had taken him three trips.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说路若接得上，走的是近道；阿荀看着外头的空处，说今日可一点也不近，光运块新凳板上来，自己就走了三回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu dào lánnèi , gé zhe kōng le de jiē láng wèizhì wǎng xī kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi stood inside the railing and looked west across the vanished gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走到栏内，隔着空了的接廊位置往西看。

pairs.target: yún mànmàn sànkāi , yuǎn pō lùchū yìtiáo xìxìde liàng biān , xiàng lù , yòu kěnéng zhǐshì shài dào guāng de yáncéng .
pairs.english: Clouds slowly parted, revealing a thin bright edge on a distant slope: perhaps a road, perhaps only sunlit rock strata.
pairs.hanzi: 云慢慢散开，远坡露出一条细细的亮边，像路，又可能只是晒到光的岩层。

pairs.target: tā méi jí zhe jiào biérén kàn , xiān zài zhǐ shàng quān le yíchù , zhùmíng shìcóng nǎlǐ wàng guòqù de .
pairs.english: He did not rush to call the others, first circling a spot on paper and noting where he had viewed it from.
pairs.hanzi: 他没急着叫别人看，先在纸上圈了一处，注明是从哪里望过去的。

pairs.target: huíqù chīfàn shí , ruǎn héng hái pěng zhe nà zhāng chāo tú , chàdiǎn jiàng yóu dī shàngqù . yù hé yìbǎ chōuzǒu , jiào tā chī wán zài kàn .
pairs.english: Back at their meal, Ruan Heng still held the copied plan and nearly dripped oil on it. Yuhe snatched it away, telling him to finish eating first.
pairs.hanzi: 回去吃饭时，阮衡还捧着那张抄图，差点将油滴上去。郁禾一把抽走，叫他吃完再看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shǒubiān yě kōng le , què rěnbúzhù zhuǎnxiàng chuāngzǐ ; xià tóu de rén zhàojiù līn zhe cài zǒuguò , shuí yě bù zhīdào tā jīnrì kànjiàn de zhènzǐ , hūrán bǐ zuótiān duōchū le yìcéng .
pairs.english: Tavi's hands were empty too, yet he kept turning to the window. Below, people passed with vegetables as usual, unaware that the town he saw today had suddenly gained a layer since yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维手边也空了，却忍不住转向窗子；下头的人照旧拎着菜走过，谁也不知道他今日看见的镇子，忽然比昨天多出了一层。
